# Paratha Land

> Paratha Land is a vegetarian Punjabi restaurant kitchen in Langley, British Columbia, Canada, known for hand-stuffed parathas (aloo, gobi, paneer, mooli, makki methi), rotis, rice bowls, curries, Punjabi sweets and chai. Customers order online at parathaland.ca for pickup. Paratha Land also offers catering and a food truck for events.

- Address: 20381 62 Ave, Unit 301, Langley, BC V3A 5E6, Canada
- Phone: (604) 340-9237
- Cuisine: Punjabi, North Indian, Indian street food, 100% vegetarian
- Tagline: Always made fresh
- Logo: https://parathaland.ca/brand/logo.jpg
- Signature dish: Aloo paratha plate
- Order online for pickup: https://parathaland.ca/#order
- Catering and food truck bookings: https://parathaland.ca/catering
- Hours and reviews: Google Business Profile for Paratha Land, Langley

## Pages
- [Home and full menu](https://parathaland.ca/): menu with prices, how an aloo paratha is made, rewards, FAQ
- [Catering & food truck](https://parathaland.ca/catering): party trays and on-site food truck service for concerts, festivals, melas, corporate events and weddings
